name: 2026 estimated tax December payment.eml
subject: HANGS Construction Services 2026 estimated tax, December payment
body:
Hi,

The December 15 estimate is coming up and I want to get it right this time. So far this year we have paid what we paid each quarter last year: $12,075.00 in April and June, and $16,000.00 in September when I saw the year was running ahead. Our 2025 return went in on October 13 with total tax of $59,302.33.

Attached are the full-year projection and the EFTPS history. The interim taxable income for the first three, six and nine months is in the folder; the winter months were slow and the January 9 bonus to Celeste came out of Q1.

Two questions:
- How much should we pay on December 15, and are we short for the earlier quarters?
- The EFTPS confirmation for the June 15 payment shows tax period 12/2025. I think I picked the wrong year. Does that matter?

Thanks,
Morgan Lee
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC
